name: issue_cert
description:
Issue a new TLS certificate for the common names (domain names) listed in the cns input.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v8/certs --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cns.description: The common names the cert should be issued for

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
